intro.heading: From an idea to running system
paragraphs: OneTrust's AI Governance wedge, as Sriram has framed it, is Platform + Solutions: detect(), assess(), act(), attest() running on a Trust Graph. The documents below are one engineer's answer to a specific question: what does that actually take to build, layer by layer, from the customer-facing surface down to the cloud foundation.

The functional architecture is OneTrust-specific, built from the high level discussion that Sriram has presented. The technical architecture is a work sample: Asset Intelligence, a production system built on the same architectural pattern this proposal is built on.

functional.heading: OneTrust — CPS + AEP
functional.description: Seven layers, two functions tagged explicitly: CPS (Core Platform & Solutions) for what exists in production today, AEP (AI Platform & Emerging Products) for what the new business builds, plus a stable facade contract where both sides meet and hand off work without either blocking the other or duplicating effort. Every layer traces back to a capability from the high level discussion with Sriram.

technical.heading: Asset Intelligence (Stealth Mode)
technical.description: A production system scoring media assets against brand, brief, and provenance requirements. Built on the same architecture pattern proposed for OneTrust's Context Layer: a foundation-model API called through typed, structured tool contracts, an orchestrator, and a closed evaluation loop. Sriram's vision for detect(), assess(), act(), attest() rests on the same core principles this platform was built on.
